description: Answers 'what's the temp inside the bedroom / in here', 'how warm is it in here', 'what's the humidity / air quality in here' from the room's IKEA VINDSTYRKA (bedroom: sensor.air_quality_monitor_*_2, kitchen: sensor.air_quality_monitor_*), and opens the Climate page on the screen in the asking satellite's area for a minute (writes input_text.overlook_voice, action climate). 'In here' / 'inside' means the asking satellite's room. Added 2026-11-08.

command: how (warm|hot|cold) is it (inside|in here|in this room|in the bedroom)
how is the air [in here|in the bedroom]

variables.s: {% set m = suffix %}{{ m[room] if room in m else none }}
variables.t: {{ states('sensor.air_quality_monitor_temperature' ~ s) | float(none) if s is not none else none }}
variables.h: {{ states('sensor.air_quality_monitor_humidity' ~ s) | float(none) if s is not none else none }}
variables.pm: {{ states('sensor.air_quality_monitor_pm2_5' ~ s) | float(none) if s is not none else none }}
variables.voc: {{ states('sensor.air_quality_monitor_voc_index' ~ s) | float(none) if s is not none else none }}
variables.name: {{ {'bedroom': 'the bedroom', 'kitchen': 'the kitchen'}.get(room, area_name(room) or 'here') }}

if.value_template: {{ s is none or t is none }}

then.set_conversation_response: I don't have a climate sensor in {{ name }}.

actions.set_conversation_response: {% set air = 'poor' if (pm or 0) > 35 or (voc or 0) > 250 else 'moderate' if (pm or 0) > 12 or (voc or 0) > 150 else 'good' %}It's {{ t | round(0) | int }} degrees in {{ name }}{% if h is not none %} with {{ h | round(0) | int }}% humidity{% endif %}. The air is {{ air }}.
